purpose: Skeleton-first pelvis landmark target constraints. Preserve the independently corroborated hip-joint centres while rebuilding the os coxae and pelvic ring from bony landmarks rather than the r95 surface.

coordinate_policy.origin: pelvic midline reference to be re-established from bilateral ASIS/PSIS and pubic/sacral landmarks
coordinate_policy.Y: posterior positive in the canonical HGPT anatomical world basis
coordinate_policy.note: Do not preserve the a003 ASIS surface Y/Z merely to stay inside the current mesh.

sources.citation: Arand C et al. 3D statistical model of the pelvic ring – a CT-based statistical evaluation of anatomical variation. J Anat. 2019;234:376-383.
sources.population: 50 uninjured Japanese adults; 30 males, 20 females; sex-specific mean models
sources.limitation: Older Japanese male sample; use as one 3D pelvic-ring source, not a universal target.

sources.citation: Musielak B et al. Variation in pelvic shape and size in Eastern European males: a computed tomography comparative study. PeerJ. 2019;7:e6433.
sources.population: 31 contemporary adult male pelves from Poland, 3D CT reconstructions
sources.limitation: Population-specific; values demonstrate realistic adult-male variation and should not be averaged blindly with the Japanese sample.

sources.citation: Multilevel Measurement of Acetabular Version Using 3-D CT-generated Models: Implications for Hip Preservation Surgery. Clin Orthop Relat Res. 2011.
sources.use: Independent male 3D-CT check for acetabular and pelvic transverse scale.

sources.citation: Sex-specific Differences of the Infraacetabular Corridor: A Biomorphometric CT-based Analysis on a Database of 523 Pelves. 2015.
sources.population: 523 pelves; 315 males; metadata subset male mean height 176 cm

current_a003.note: ASIS points are low-confidence mesh/groove-derived skin proxies; HJC is independently corroborated and is treated differently.

inter_ASIS.interpretation: A003 inter-ASIS is at the low end of adult-male 3D CT values but not a gross impossibility. Because its ASIS are surface/groove proxies, canonical ASIS breadth should be rebuilt from bone landmarks rather than simply widened to a population mean.

interacetabular_HJC.interpretation: The a003 bilateral HJC spacing is close to the male 3D-CT interacetabular mean and strongly supports retaining the HJC transverse scale provisionally.

acetabular_diameter.interpretation: Use as the acetabular envelope scale around the retained HJC, not as a femoral-head diameter substitute.

canonical_landmarks_required_per_side: SI auricular-surface centre and local frame
hard_invariants: left/right HJC remain distinct and lie inside their acetabular envelopes
pubic symphysis is a midline cartilaginous contact, not a merged left/right hip bone
sacrum remains distinct from both os coxae
each adult os coxae remains one conventional bone despite ilium/ischium/pubis landmark regions
pelvic frame is constructed from bony landmarks rather than r95 skin breadth
next_steps: Map a canonical male pelvic transverse family using inter-ASIS, inter-AIIS, interischial-spine and interacetabular corridors without forcing all measurements to one population mean.
Add AP depth via ASIS↔PSIS / promontory↔symphysis constraints with matching definitions.
Construct left/right os coxae local landmark frames around the retained HJC and acetabular-diameter corridor.
Then solve SI auricular contacts and pubic-symphysis closure before Blender instantiation.
